reason: After the night the police came to the door, I would rather spend the money than lie awake wondering where he is. Thirty days with a refund is the only reason I would even consider it, because I have been burned by apps that promise everything and then drop the connection.
objection: Will it actually connect when he is somewhere with no signal, and will he keep it on? He pulls things off his body, and I cannot afford a $249 device that ends up in a drain while I pay $25 a month for it.
would_change_my_mind: A live demo on a real walk where it connects through a dead zone and the locking harness stays on a kid who pulls at everything.
